summary: This class features an interview with Joe J. Gindy, a student at Rutgers University who shares his experiences as a Jewish campus activist following October 7th. He discusses his testimony before Congress regarding the atmosphere on campus and provides advice for students on how to remain proud of their heritage while navigating college life.
questions: How can students prepare for college before they arrive?
What should a student do if they face anti-Semitism on campus?
Is it better to dorm or commute to college?
How can Jewish students get involved on campus?
What is the impact of speaking out against anti-Semitism?
